name: plugin-update help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:plugin-update. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Keep its data (settings, history) for the new build
entries.text: Turns “Keep its data (settings, history) for the new build” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Plugin Update.

entries.title: Remove the old build and install the new one
entries.text: Removes the old build and install the new one. Depending on your behaviour theme it asks first. Part of Plugin Update.

entries.title: Park the rebuild
entries.text: Parks the rebuild. Part of Plugin Update.

entries.title: Open Plugin Update
entries.text: Opens plugin Update. Part of Plugin Update.

entries.title: Plugin Update
entries.text: Shows “Plugin Update”. Part of Plugin Update.

entries.title: Plugin Update
entries.text: Shows the “Plugin Update” part of this screen. Part of Plugin Update.
